title: Master Direction – KYC (Amendment) Direction, 2026
summary: Annual re-KYC for high-risk customers, beneficial ownership threshold cut to 10%, mandatory PAN-Aadhaar verification, CRILC reporting of KYC exceptions, eight-year retention and board-level governance.

title: Digital Lending Directions, 2025 – Amendment 2026
summary: Default loss guarantee cap raised to 10%, vernacular key fact statement with explicit acknowledgement, cooling-off period extended to seven days and CIC reporting of lending service providers.

title: Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework – Amendment 2026
summary: 24x7 SOC monitoring with 180-day log retention, annual third-party cyber assessments and six-hour incident reporting to SEBI.

title: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025
summary: Consolidated digital lending directions for RE-LSP arrangements, multi-lender disclosures, DLG cap at five per cent, data storage and reporting of digital lending apps. Repeals the 2022 Guidelines and the 2023 DLG circular.
